description: Instructions for Schedule D, worksheet line 4, Steps 1–3: a rental building (selling price $500,000, cost $400,000, straight-line depreciation $150,000) sold on the installment method; gain $250,000, no recapture, unrecaptured § 1250 gain $150,000 (the depreciation), gross profit percentage 50%. $100,000 was received in the year of sale ($50,000 gain, all unrecaptured). This year $300,000 is received: $150,000 gain, of which the $100,000 remaining is unrecaptured § 1250 gain; nothing is left.
